newsitem.title: FRANCE: France reports refund and tax bids for wheat.
newsitem.headline: France reports refund and tax bids for wheat.

text.p: Grain traders put in 32 bids for a total of 1,132,500 tonnes of European Union soft wheat on Thursday with both taxes and refunds, cereals office ONIC said.
It said offers to pay taxes ranged between 0.14 Ecus and 2.0 Ecus per tonne.
Bids for refunds ranged from zero to 14.99 Ecus per tonne.
It did not publish sub-totals for the volumes sought in taxes and refunds.
Traders can bid for either taxes or refunds but the European Commission generally grants one or the other, not both.
Traders also bid for 398,000 tonnes of barley at refunds of 9.90 to 27.87 Ecus per tonne.
There were no bids for rye.
